mapper.select: select * from using_time where TO_CHAR(update_date,'yy/MM/dd') = TO_CHAR((select max(update_date) from using_time),'yy/MM/dd')
select sum(appTime) from using_time where TO_CHAR(update_date,'yy/MM/dd') > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7,'yy/MM/dd') group by TO_CHAR(update_date,'yy/MM/dd') order by TO_CHAR(update_date,'yy/MM/dd') desc

select a.phoneNum,a.appName,sum(a.appTime) as appTime,ROUND(a.appTime/ (select sum(appTime) from using_time where phoneNum = #{phoneNum})*100,2) as sumTime from using_time a where a.phoneNum = #{phoneNum} group by a.phoneNum,a.appName,a.appTime having sum(a.appTime) != 0
